北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适。别忘了带件外套，以防降温哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and pleasant. Keep a light jacket handy for cooler moments!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天有风，体感 15℃。早晚温差大，注意保暖别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a breeze, feeling 15℃. Remember to dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚，体感舒适。享受这好天气，记得多喝水哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the beautiful weather, and stay hydrated!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨蒙蒙，湿度高。出门别忘带伞，小心路滑！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella, and watch your step!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，风力 3级，湿度大。体感舒适，保持心情愉悦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with a breeze, humid. It feels pleasant, stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有风，体感微凉。多穿一件，暖暖和和出门哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and breezy, feeling a bit cool. Layer up to stay warm outside.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天微凉，风力 3级。记得多加件衣服，注意别着凉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool with a breeze. Remember to add a layer and don't catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温舒适。微风拂面，享受惬意的一天吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Enjoy this pleasant day with a gentle breeze!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 20℃。微风习习，记得带件薄外套。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feeling 20℃. With a gentle breeze, keep a light jacket handy.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感温度舒适。美好的一天，从好心情开始！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Start your beautiful day with a good mood!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴空万里，体感温暖。阳光正好，出去走走吧！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and warm. The sunshine is perfect, go out for a stroll!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 16℃。记得添衣，别着凉，注意补水哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny, feeling 16℃. Remember to dress warmly, and stay hydrated!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 10℃，风力 6级。风大降温，务必穿厚实！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels 10℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly to brave the wind and cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，微凉。出门别忘带伞，也要注意保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain and is cool. Don't forget your umbrella, and stay warm.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力 4级。体感偏凉，记得多穿一件衣服。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with moderate winds, feeling cool. Remember to wear an extra layer.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴朗，体感 10℃，风力 6级。风力大，注意防风保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is sunny but feels 10℃ with strong winds. Stay warm and protect yourself from the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 8℃，风力 6级。风大寒冷，务必多穿！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels 8℃ with strong winds. It's windy and cold, so bundle up!
